title: Ice and sunlight at the Moon’s south pole
description:
Astronomers say the Moon’s south pole is a prime place for the first Moon base. Artemis may land nearby.
NASA picture: JPL, PIA00001. Clementine mission, south pole mosaic.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
Today’s APOD photo is by Alejandro Sanz: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-7-de-gerlache-kocher-massif/. To use it, please ask the owner.
